notes: SessionSifu 3.5.32 adds layout restore safeguards: rechecks cancellation and window lifetime after asynchronous waits, invalidates stale geometry after monitor changes with a one-second quiet period, and requires observed unmaximization before resize within a two-second deadline. Keeps unresolved records, conservative launch pacing and serialized compositor operations. Includes preceding scheduling, tiling, recovery and autostart fixes. Isolated tests do not prove native Wayland stability.
